 Sikar Weather Update: Clouds Cover Eastern Areas | Northerly Winds Chill
 Northerly winds bring chill to Sikar: Clouds cover eastern areas in morning, know what weather will be like this week
 Sikar 2 days ago 
 Copy link 
 The impact of northerly winds has intensified in Sikar, bringing a chill to the air. People felt cold due to the chilly winds that blew last night. Cold winds continued across the district on Wednesday morning. Light clouds remained over the eastern areas. According to the Meteorological Department, severe cold will continue to affect the district for the next two days.
 Sikar's weather has changed rapidly over the past week. The cold has intensified as northerly winds have strengthened at night. Night-time temperatures are expected to fall slightly over the next two days. Before this, the weather remained clear throughout Tuesday, and strong sunshine made it feel warm.
 According to the meteorological centre at the Fatehpur Agricultural Research Centre, the minimum temperature on Wednesday morning was recorded at 7.4°C. On Tuesday, the maximum temperature was recorded at 28.5°C and the minimum temperature at 6.9°C.
 According to Jaipur Meteorological Centre Director Radheshyam Sharma, the impact of northerly winds is likely to continue in Sikar district for the next 2 to 3 days. The pressure from the winds will lead to fluctuations in temperatures. Meanwhile, the weather in the district is expected to change again after three days.
